data.one_liner: Create and maintain ongoing activity notifications on Wear OS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to create, update, and stop ongoing activity notifications specifically for Wear OS devices. It manages custom templates, stopwatch parts, and timer parts to display active states.
use_when: You are developing a Wear OS app in Flutter that needs ongoing activities.
You need to show live workouts, timers, or countdowns in the Wear OS UI.
avoid_when: Your target platform is standard mobile or desktop instead of Wear OS.
You only need standard local push notifications.
strengths: Specialized for Wear OS ongoing activities.
Provides simple start, update, and stop methods.
weaknesses: Requires manual Android manifest configuration and foreground service permissions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding foreground service permissions and the OngoingActivityService to AndroidManifest.xml.
